text:
Alyssa: Hey team — opened a docs PR to update the model catalog for Zephyr-Aurora v1.2 quantized support and long-seq limits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4182 Can reviewers sanity-check the SDK snippets and the compatibility note? cc @Ben @Carmen :eyes:
Ben: taking a look now. Quick note: runtime expects a quantize_profile key rather than a boolean `quantize`. I can confirm exact field names with eng-runtime this afternoon.
Carmen: will we also include the 2k/4k bench numbers in the card? I have preliminary numbers but need to clean them up.
Alyssa: yes — checklist in the PR: 1) update "supported variants" table, 2) add migration guidance for quantized variants, 3) add updated python/node SDK examples, 4) fix broken link to compatibility matrix (it points to the old page atm).
Docs Bot: Heads up — found a template link in model-card template pointing to /docs/model-cat/compat which is stale. Suggest replacing with /docs/compatibility/matrix.
Ben: agreed. Also runtime has an auto-fallback for sequences >4096 to the longseq-compatible variant — we should call that out so customers know behavior. See runtime issue #2109.
Alyssa: good call. I'm going to add a short note: "Requests above 4096 tokens will route to zephyr-aurora-v1.2-longseq (compatible variant) — expect ~1.3x latency."
Ben: for the SDK snippet, propose switching to the newer API shape. Example (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=REDACTED)
resp = client.generate(
    model="zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8",
    input="Summarize the following...",
    options={"quantize_profile": "int8", "max_tokens": 256}
)
print(resp.text)
```
And node (short):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8', input: '...', options: { quantize_profile: 'int8', max_tokens: 256 } })
console.log(r.text)
```
Carmen: that looks good — add a note about quality regression for int8 on very long context (>2k). I'll paste error/bleed numbers by EOD.
Alyssa: I'll update the PR with the new snippets and the link fix. Leaving a TODO for Carmen's bench table — marking it as DRAFT until we have numbers.
Ben: small nit: in the model-card limits table you wrote "max_context: 4096" but runtime enforces 4096 for int8 and 8192 for fp16. Might be better to show a per-variant column.
Alyssa: adding per-variant limits column now.
Deploy Bot: preview build for PR #4182 published: https://deploy-previews.internal.redwood/4182 (staging) :white_check_mark:
Carmen: added bench numbers to PR comment. 2k seq latency (p50) int8: 72ms, fp16: 58ms. Throughput numbers included too.
Alyssa: perfect — thanks Carmen. I'll run one quick doc spellcheck and then merge.
Ben: once merged, can we also add a tiny changelog entry for "Model card: zephyr-aurora v1.2 — quantized variant and longseq notes"? Customers ask for changelogs often.
Alyssa: will add. Merging after one more quick pass. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
